season.name: Fall
season.line: What did the year produce, what does it owe, and who will share the bread?

movement.name: The Attention
movement.line: Hear the alarm while there is time to answer.

days.t: Who knows how to number his days?
x: and [who knows how] to number [his days] because of the fear of thy wrath? So manifest thy right hand, and those that are instructed in wisdom in the heart.
And now thus saith the Lord Almighty; Consider your ways, I pray you.

Ye have sown much, but brought in little; ye have eaten, and are not satisfied; ye have drunk, and are not satisfied with drink, ye have clothed yourselves, and have not become warm thereby: and he that earns wages has gathered [them] into a bag full of holes.

days.t: Know the number of your flock
x: Do thou thoroughly know the number of thy flock, and pay attention to thine herds.
For which of you⁺, wanting to build a tower, does not first, having sat down, count the cost, whether he has the [things] for [its] completion,

days.t: The rich man and his full barns
x: And He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.
And he was reasoning within himself, saying, ‘What shall I do, because I have nowhere I will store up my fruits?’
And he said, ‘This I will do: I will tear down my barns and will build larger ones, and I will gather there all my grain and goods.
And I will say to my soul, “Soul, you have many good things laid up for many years; take your rest, eat, drink, be merry.”’
But let a man examine himself, and thus let him eat of the bread, and let him drink of the cup.
